title.zh: ⚡️Papertrade已正式上线，11,465个地址存入1.38亿美元
title.en: ⚡️Papertrade已正式上线，11,465个地址存入1.38亿美元

current_state.zh: Papertrade 继续运营：累计名义成交额超 5840 亿美元，未平仓合约名义价值约 23.13 亿美元，保证金约 1639.80 万美元；PAPER 质押比例约 98.92%，累计质押者奖励约 2402.10 万美元；资金池净资金约 387.57 万美元，当前排队待付金额为零。
current_state.en: Papertrade remains live: cumulative notional volume over $58.4 billion, open interest notional around $2.313 billion, margin around $16.398 million; PAPER staking ratio about 98.92%, cumulative staker rewards about $24.021 million; pool net funds about $3.8757 million, with zero pending payout queue.

updates.title_zh: ⚡️Papertrade已正式上线，11,465个地址存入1.38亿美元
updates.title_en: ⚡️Papertrade已正式上线，11,465个地址存入1.38亿美元
updates.what_changed_zh: Papertrade 是 HyperEVM 上一个完全链上的合成永续合约协议，其定价基于 Hyperliquid 的订单簿中间价，并仅通过用户亏损和清算来铸造其 PAPER 代币，该协议在完成来自 11,465 个地址的 1.38 亿美元预存款后已正式上线。
updates.what_changed_en: Papertrade, a fully on-chain synthetic perpetuals protocol on HyperEVM that prices off Hyperliquid's order-book midpoint and mints its PAPER token solely from user losses and liquidations, has officially launched after closing pre-deposits of $138 million from 11,465 addresses.
updates.current_state_zh: Papertrade 是 HyperEVM 上一个完全链上的合成永续合约协议，其定价基于 Hyperliquid 的订单簿中间价，并仅通过用户亏损和清算来铸造其 PAPER 代币，该协议在完成来自 11,465 个地址的 1.38 亿美元预存款后已正式上线。
updates.current_state_en: Papertrade, a fully on-chain synthetic perpetuals protocol on HyperEVM that prices off Hyperliquid's order-book midpoint and mints its PAPER token solely from user losses and liquidations, has officially launched after closing pre-deposits of $138 million from 11,465 addresses.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Papertrade, a fully on-chain synthetic perpetuals protocol on HyperEVM that prices off Hyperliquid's order-book midpoint and mints its PAPER token solely from user losses and liquidations, has officially launched after closing pre-deposits of $138 million from 11,465 addresses.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Papertrade, a fully on-chain synthetic perpetuals protocol on HyperEVM that prices off Hyperliquid's order-book midpoint and mints its PAPER token solely from user losses and liquidations, has officially launched after closing pre-deposits of $138 million from 11,465 addresses.

updates.title_zh: ⚡️Papertrade上线半小时，PAPER代币排放进入衰减模式
updates.title_en: ⚡️Papertrade上线半小时，PAPER代币排放进入衰减模式
updates.what_changed_zh: 上线半小时，平台累计成交量达399亿美元；LP余额超过200万美元后，PAPER代币排放进入衰减模式。
updates.what_changed_en: Within the first half-hour after launch, cumulative volume reached $39.9 billion; after LP balances exceeded $2 million, PAPER token emissions moved into decay mode.
updates.current_state_zh: Papertrade 已正式上线，上线半小时累计成交量达399亿美元，LP余额超过200万美元，PAPER代币排放已进入衰减模式。
updates.current_state_en: Papertrade has officially launched; within the first half-hour cumulative volume reached $39.9 billion, LP balances exceeded $2 million, and PAPER token emissions have entered decay mode.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Papertrade, a HyperEVM-based on-chain synthetic perpetuals platform that prices off Hyperliquid's order book BBO and mints PAPER tokens against user losses, launched with $39.9B in first-half-hour volume and moved into PAPER emission-decay mode after LP balances exceeded $2M.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Papertrade, a HyperEVM-based on-chain synthetic perpetuals platform that prices off Hyperliquid's order book BBO and mints PAPER tokens against user losses, launched with $39.9B in first-half-hour volume and moved into PAPER emission-decay mode after LP balances exceeded $2M.

updates.title_zh: Papertrade累计名义成交额超5730亿美元，未平仓合约头寸达33亿美元
updates.title_en: Papertrade累计名义成交额超5730亿美元，未平仓合约头寸达33亿美元
updates.what_changed_zh: 上线约一天后，Papertrade 累计名义成交额超过 5730 亿美元，未平仓合约头寸达 33.22 亿美元，对应保证金 2029 万美元。
updates.what_changed_en: Roughly one day after launch, Papertrade reported over $573 billion in cumulative notional volume and $3.32 billion in open interest, backed by $20.29 million in position margin.
updates.current_state_zh: Papertrade 已上线并继续运营，累计名义成交额超 5730 亿美元，未平仓合约头寸约 33.22 亿美元，保证金约 2029 万美元，PAPER 代币排放处于衰减模式。
updates.current_state_en: Papertrade remains live with cumulative notional volume over $573 billion, open interest around $3.32 billion, margin around $20.29 million, and PAPER token emissions in decay mode.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: HyperEVM-based synthetic perpetuals protocol Papertrade reported over $573 billion in cumulative notional volume and $3.32 billion in open interest within roughly one day of launch, backed by $20.29 million in position margin, with its PAPER token minted solely from user losses and liquidations.
updates.detailed_summary_en: HyperEVM-based synthetic perpetuals protocol Papertrade reported over $573 billion in cumulative notional volume and $3.32 billion in open interest within roughly one day of launch, backed by $20.29 million in position margin, with its PAPER token minted solely from user losses and liquidations.

updates.title_zh: 【papertrade 上线以来累计名义成交额超 5840 亿美元，累计质押者奖励约 2402 万美元】
updates.title_en: 【papertrade 上线以来累计名义成交额超 5840 亿美元，累计质押者奖励约 2402 万美元】
updates.what_changed_zh: Papertrade 更新运营数据：累计名义成交额超 5840 亿美元，未平仓合约名义价值约 23.13 亿美元，对应保证金约 1639.80 万美元；PAPER 总供应约 51.62 亿枚，其中约 51.06 亿枚已质押（约 98.92%），累计质押者奖励约 2402.10 万美元；资金池账面余额约 415.34 万美元，计入浮盈浮亏后净资金约 387.57 万美元，当前排队待付金额为零。
updates.what_changed_en: Papertrade updated operating metrics: cumulative notional volume over $58.4 billion, open interest notional around $2.313 billion, backing margin around $16.398 million; PAPER supply about 5.162 billion with about 5.106 billion staked (~98.92%); cumulative staker rewards about $24.021 million; pool book balance about $4.1534 million, net of unrealized PnL about $3.8757 million, and zero pending payout queue.
updates.current_state_zh: Papertrade 继续运营：累计名义成交额超 5840 亿美元，未平仓合约名义价值约 23.13 亿美元，保证金约 1639.80 万美元；PAPER 质押比例约 98.92%，累计质押者奖励约 2402.10 万美元；资金池净资金约 387.57 万美元，当前排队待付金额为零。
updates.current_state_en: Papertrade remains live: cumulative notional volume over $58.4 billion, open interest notional around $2.313 billion, margin around $16.398 million; PAPER staking ratio about 98.92%, cumulative staker rewards about $24.021 million; pool net funds about $3.8757 million, with zero pending payout queue.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: HyperEVM-based perpetuals platform papertrade reports over $584 billion in cumulative notional volume, ~$2.31 billion open interest and ~98.9% of its PAPER supply staked just hours after launch, despite a trading pool holding only about $4.15 million in net funds.
updates.detailed_summary_en: HyperEVM-based perpetuals platform papertrade reports over $584 billion in cumulative notional volume, ~$2.31 billion open interest and ~98.9% of its PAPER supply staked just hours after launch, despite a trading pool holding only about $4.15 million in net funds.
